a) To promote the welfare, safety, and common interests of the residents of Sunrise Enclave.

b) To maintain and manage the common areas, amenities, and facilities of the premises.

c) To undertake repairs, maintenance, and improvement of common property.

d) To organize cultural, social, and recreational activities for the residents.

e) To liaise with local authorities, utility providers, and other agencies on matters affecting the residents.

f) To collect fees, subscriptions, and contributions from members for the purposes of the Society.

g) To do all such other lawful acts and things as may be incidental or conducive to the attainment of the above objectives.

**4. MEMBERSHIP**

**4.1 Eligibility**
Any person who is a legal owner or a tenant of a residential unit within Sunrise Enclave shall be eligible to become a member of the Society. Membership shall be open to all without discrimination of caste, creed, religion, or gender.

**4.2 Admission**
Application for membership shall be made in the prescribed form, accompanied by the admission fee and the first year's subscription. The Managing Committee shall have the power to approve or reject any application, provided that the reasons for rejection are recorded in writing.

**4.3 Rights of Members**
Every member shall have the right to:
- Participate in the General Body meetings.
- Vote on matters placed before the General Body.
- Avail of the facilities and amenities of the Society subject to rules.

The registration certificate states that Sunrise Residency Welfare Association is registered under Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act, 1975. Record status: current.

**4.4 Cessation of Membership**
Membership shall cease upon:
- Written resignation.
- Transfer of ownership or termination of tenancy.
- Expulsion by the Managing Committee for violation of the bylaws, subject to ratification by the General Body.

**5. SUBSCRIPTION AND FEES**

**5.1 Admission Fee**
An admission fee of Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) shall be payable at the time of admission.

**5.2 Monthly Subscription**
The monthly subscription shall be Rs. 200/- per unit, payable on or before the 10th of every month. A late fee of Rs. 25/- per month shall be levied for delayed payment.

**5.3 Special Levies**
The General Body may, by a resolution passed by a two-thirds majority, impose special levies for specific purposes such as major repairs, festivals, or capital improvements.

**6. GENERAL BODY MEETINGS**

**6.1 Annual General Meeting**
The Annual General Meeting (AGM) shall be held once every calendar year, within six months of the close of the financial year. Notice of the AGM shall be circulated at least 14 days in advance.

**6.2 Special General Meeting**
A Special General Meeting may be convened by the Managing Committee or upon a written requisition signed by not less than one-fifth of the total members.

**6.3 Quorum**
The quorum for a General Body meeting shall be one-tenth of the total members or 15 members, whichever is less. If the quorum is not present within 30 minutes of the scheduled time, the meeting shall be adjourned to a later date, and the members present at the adjourned meeting shall constitute the quorum.

**6.4 Voting**
Each member shall have one vote. Voting shall ordinarily be by show of hands, unless a secret ballot is demanded by at least five members. Proxy voting shall not be permitted.

**7. MANAGING COMMITTEE**
**7.6 Vacation of Office**
The office of a Committee member shall be vacated upon:
- Resignation in writing addressed to the Secretary.
- Ceasing to be a member of the Society.
- Absence from three (3) consecutive Committee meetings without leave of absence.
- Removal by a resolution passed by a two-thirds majority of the General Body.

**7.7 Filling of Casual Vacancies**
Casual vacancies in the Managing Committee may be filled by the Committee by co-option. Members so co-opted shall hold office only for the remainder of the term of the Committee.

**8. AMENDMENT OF BYLAWS**

**8.1 Procedure for Amendment**
These bylaws may be amended only by a resolution passed by a two-thirds majority of the members present and voting at a General Body meeting. Notice of the proposed amendment shall be circulated to all members at least twenty-one (21) days before the date of the meeting. No amendment shall be effective unless and until it is registered with the Registrar of Societies under the Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act, 1975, and the registration certificate is updated accordingly.

**8.2 Record of Amendments**
All amendments shall be recorded in the bylaws with the date of the General Body resolution and the date of registration with the Registrar of Societies. The Secretary shall maintain an up-to-date copy of the bylaws incorporating all amendments.

**9. FINANCE AND ACCOUNTS**

**9.1 Financial Year**
The financial year of the Society shall be from 1st April to 31st March of the following year.

**9.2 Accounts and Audit**
The accounts of the Society shall be maintained by the Treasurer and shall be audited annually by a Chartered Accountant appointed by the General Body. The audited accounts shall be presented at the Annual General Meeting.

**9.3 Bank Account**
The Society shall maintain a bank account in the name of "Sunrise Residency Welfare Association." The account shall be operated jointly by the President, the Secretary, and the Treasurer, with any two of them signing jointly.

**9.4 Utilization of Funds**
The funds of the Society shall be utilized only for the objectives of the Society as stated in the Memorandum of Association and these bylaws. No part of the funds shall be distributed amongst the members.

**10. DISSOLUTION**

**10.1 Dissolution Procedure**
The Society may be dissolved by a resolution passed by a three-fourths majority of the total members at a Special General Meeting convened for the purpose. Upon dissolution, the assets of the Society, after settlement of all liabilities, shall be transferred or donated to another society or charitable institution having similar objectives, as decided by the General Body, and shall not be distributed amongst the members.

**11. INDEMNITY**

**11.1 Indemnity of Office Bearers**
Every member of the Managing Committee and every office bearer shall be indemnified by the Society against all losses and expenses incurred by them in the discharge of their duties, except in cases of fraud, dishonesty, or willful default.

**12. REGISTRATION**

The Society is registered under the Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act, 1975. The registration certificate lists the Sunrise Residency Welfare Association registration number as 123/2010. Record status: current. The certificate is in the custody of the Secretary and may be inspected by any member upon reasonable notice.

**13. INTERPRETATION AND DISPUTES**

**13.1 Interpretation**
In the event of any doubt or dispute regarding the interpretation of these bylaws, the decision of the Managing Committee shall be final, subject to an appeal to the General Body.

**13.
**14. AMENDMENTS TO BYLAWS**

**14.1 Procedure for Amendment**
These bylaws may be amended, added to, or repealed by a resolution passed by a two-thirds majority of the members present and voting at a General Body Meeting, provided that notice of the proposed amendment has been given in writing at least fourteen days prior to the date of such meeting. The notice shall set out the text of the proposed amendment and the reasons therefor.

**14.2 Record of Amendments**
All amendments shall be numbered serially and recorded in the Amendment Register maintained by the Secretary. Each entry shall state the date of the General Body Meeting at which the amendment was passed, the clause or clauses affected, and the text of the amendment as adopted. The entry shall be signed by the President and the Secretary.

**14.3 Amendment History**

| Sr. No. | Date of GBM | Clause Amended | Nature of Amendment |
|---------|-------------|----------------|---------------------|
| 1 | 12-06-2011 | 5.2 | Clarified that nomination for Managing Committee must be proposed and seconded by two members in good standing. |
| 2 | 18-11-2012 | 8.1 | Extended the financial year to end on 31st March, in line with the Income Tax Act. |
| 3 | 25-08-2014 | 7.4 | Added provision for electronic communication of meeting notices to members who have provided email addresses. |
| 4 | 09-04-2017 | 6.3 | Reduced the quorum for Extraordinary General Meetings from one-third to one-fourth of total members, subject to a minimum of ten members. |
| 5 | 03-02-2020 | 9.2 | Specified that the Statutory Auditor shall hold office for a term of one year and shall be eligible for reappointment. |
| 6 | 21-09-2022 | 4.1 | Inserted sub-clause on maintenance of a register of members' vehicles and parking allocation. |

**15. MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS**

**15.1 Common Seal**
The Society shall have a common seal which shall remain in the custody of the Secretary. The seal shall not be affixed to any document except in the presence of the President or the Treasurer, who shall sign the document as witnesses to the affixing of the seal.

**15.2 Notices**
Any notice required to be given to a member under these bylaws shall be deemed to have been duly served if sent by post to the member's registered address or, where the member has provided an email address, by electronic mail. Proof of dispatch shall be conclusive evidence of service.

**15.3 Grievance Redressal**
Any member aggrieved by a decision of the Managing Committee may submit a written grievance to the Secretary within fifteen days of the decision. The Managing Committee shall consider the grievance at its next meeting and communicate its decision in writing within fifteen days thereof. If the member remains dissatisfied, the matter may be referred to the General Body at its next meeting.

**15.4 Arbitration**
In the event of any dispute arising between the Society and any member, or between members, regarding the affairs of the Society, the matter shall, failing amicable settlement, be referred to arbitration in accordance with the provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The arbitration shall be conducted in Chennai, and the award of the arbitrator shall be final and binding on all parties.

**15.5 Inspection of Records**
The following records shall be open to inspection by any member at the office of the Society during reasonable hours, upon prior appointment with the Secretary:
(a) The Memorandum of Association and these bylaws;
(b) The minutes of all General Body Meetings and Managing Committee Meetings;
(c) The audited accounts and balance sheets for the last three financial years;
(d) The register of members;
(e) The registration certificate.

**4. MEMBERSHIP**

**4.1 Eligibility**
Any person who is a legal owner or a tenant of a residential unit within Sunrise Enclave shall be eligible to become a member of the Society. Membership shall be open to all without discrimination of caste, creed, religion, or gender.

**4.2 Admission**
Application for membership shall be made in the prescribed form, accompanied by the admission fee and the first year's subscription. The Managing Committee shall have the power to approve or reject any application, provided that the reasons for rejection are recorded in writing.

**4.3 Rights of Members**
Every member shall have the right to:
- Participate in the General Body meetings.
- Vote on matters placed before the General Body.
- Avail of the facilities and amenities of the Society subject to rules.

The registration certificate states that Sunrise Residency Welfare Association is registered under Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act, 1975. Record status: current.

**4.4 Cessation of Membership**
Membership shall cease upon:
- Written resignation.
- Transfer of ownership or termination of tenancy.
- Expulsion by the Managing Committee for violation of the bylaws, subject to ratification by the General Body.

**5. SUBSCRIPTION AND FEES**

**5.1 Admission Fee**
An admission fee of Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only) shall be payable at the time of admission.

**5.2 Monthly Subscription**
The monthly subscription shall be Rs. 200/- per unit, payable on or before the 10th of every month. A late fee of Rs. 25/- per month shall be levied for delayed payment.

**5.3 Special Levies**
The General Body may, by a resolution passed by a two-thirds majority, impose special levies for specific purposes such as major repairs, festivals, or capital improvements.

**6. GENERAL BODY MEETINGS**

**6.1 Annual General Meeting**
The Annual General Meeting (AGM) shall be held once every calendar year, within six months of the close of the financial year. Notice of the AGM shall be circulated at least 14 days in advance.

**6.2 Special General Meeting**
A Special General Meeting may be convened by the Managing Committee or upon a written requisition signed by not less than one-fifth of the total members.

**6.3 Quorum**
The quorum for a General Body meeting shall be one-tenth of the total members or 15 members, whichever is less. If the quorum is not present within 30 minutes of the scheduled time, the meeting shall be adjourned to a later date, and the members present at the adjourned meeting shall constitute the quorum.

**6.4 Voting**
Each member shall have one vote. Voting shall ordinarily be by show of hands, unless a secret ballot is demanded by at least five members. Proxy voting shall not be permitted.

**7.6 Vacation of Office**
The office of a Committee member shall be vacated upon:
- Resignation in writing addressed to the Secretary.
- Ceasing to be a member of the Society.
- Absence from three (3) consecutive Committee meetings without leave of absence.
- Removal by a resolution passed by a two-thirds majority of the General Body.

**7.7 Filling of Casual Vacancies**
Casual vacancies in the Managing Committee may be filled by the Committee by co-option. Members so co-opted shall hold office only for the remainder of the term of the Committee.

**8. AMENDMENT OF BYLAWS**

**8.1 Procedure for Amendment**
These bylaws may be amended only by a resolution passed by a two-thirds majority of the members present and voting at a General Body meeting. Notice of the proposed amendment shall be circulated to all members at least twenty-one (21) days before the date of the meeting. No amendment shall be effective unless and until it is registered with the Registrar of Societies under the Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act, 1975, and the registration certificate is updated accordingly.

**8.2 Record of Amendments**
All amendments shall be recorded in the bylaws with the date of the General Body resolution and the date of registration with the Registrar of Societies. The Secretary shall maintain an up-to-date copy of the bylaws incorporating all amendments.

**9. FINANCE AND ACCOUNTS**

**9.1 Financial Year**
The financial year of the Society shall be from 1st April to 31st March of the following year.

**9.2 Accounts and Audit**
The accounts of the Society shall be maintained by the Treasurer and shall be audited annually by a Chartered Accountant appointed by the General Body. The audited accounts shall be presented at the Annual General Meeting.

**9.3 Bank Account**
The Society shall maintain a bank account in the name of "Sunrise Residency Welfare Association." The account shall be operated jointly by the President, the Secretary, and the Treasurer, with any two of them signing jointly.

**9.4 Utilization of Funds**
The funds of the Society shall be utilized only for the objectives of the Society as stated in the Memorandum of Association and these bylaws. No part of the funds shall be distributed amongst the members.

**10. DISSOLUTION**

**10.1 Dissolution Procedure**
The Society may be dissolved by a resolution passed by a three-fourths majority of the total members at a Special General Meeting convened for the purpose. Upon dissolution, the assets of the Society, after settlement of all liabilities, shall be transferred or donated to another society or charitable institution having similar objectives, as decided by the General Body, and shall not be distributed amongst the members.

**11. INDEMNITY**

**11.1 Indemnity of Office Bearers**
Every member of the Managing Committee and every office bearer shall be indemnified by the Society against all losses and expenses incurred by them in the discharge of their duties, except in cases of fraud, dishonesty, or willful default.

**12. REGISTRATION**

The Society is registered under the Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act, 1975. The registration certificate lists the Sunrise Residency Welfare Association registration number as 123/2010. Record status: current. The certificate is in the custody of the Secretary and may be inspected by any member upon reasonable notice.

**13. INTERPRETATION AND DISPUTES**

**13.1 Interpretation**
In the event of any doubt or dispute regarding the interpretation of these bylaws, the decision of the Managing Committee shall be final, subject to an appeal to the General Body.

**14. AMENDMENTS TO BYLAWS**

**14.1 Procedure for Amendment**
These bylaws may be amended, added to, or repealed by a resolution passed by a two-thirds majority of the members present and voting at a General Body Meeting, provided that notice of the proposed amendment has been given in writing at least fourteen days prior to the date of such meeting. The notice shall set out the text of the proposed amendment and the reasons therefor.

**14.2 Record of Amendments**
All amendments shall be numbered serially and recorded in the Amendment Register maintained by the Secretary. Each entry shall state the date of the General Body Meeting at which the amendment was passed, the clause or clauses affected, and the text of the amendment as adopted. The entry shall be signed by the President and the Secretary.

**14.3 Amendment History**

| Sr. No. | Date of GBM | Clause Amended | Nature of Amendment |
|---------|-------------|----------------|---------------------|
| 1 | 12-06-2011 | 5.2 | Clarified that nomination for Managing Committee must be proposed and seconded by two members in good standing. |
| 2 | 18-11-2012 | 8.1 | Extended the financial year to end on 31st March, in line with the Income Tax Act. |
| 3 | 25-08-2014 | 7.4 | Added provision for electronic communication of meeting notices to members who have provided email addresses. |
| 4 | 09-04-2017 | 6.3 | Reduced the quorum for Extraordinary General Meetings from one-third to one-fourth of total members, subject to a minimum of ten members. |
| 5 | 03-02-2020 | 9.2 | Specified that the Statutory Auditor shall hold office for a term of one year and shall be eligible for reappointment. |
| 6 | 21-09-2022 | 4.1 | Inserted sub-clause on maintenance of a register of members' vehicles and parking allocation. |

**15. MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS**

**15.1 Common Seal**
The Society shall have a common seal which shall remain in the custody of the Secretary. The seal shall not be affixed to any document except in the presence of the President or the Treasurer, who shall sign the document as witnesses to the affixing of the seal.

**15.2 Notices**
Any notice required to be given to a member under these bylaws shall be deemed to have been duly served if sent by post to the member's registered address or, where the member has provided an email address, by electronic mail. Proof of dispatch shall be conclusive evidence of service.

**15.3 Grievance Redressal**
Any member aggrieved by a decision of the Managing Committee may submit a written grievance to the Secretary within fifteen days of the decision. The Managing Committee shall consider the grievance at its next meeting and communicate its decision in writing within fifteen days thereof. If the member remains dissatisfied, the matter may be referred to the General Body at its next meeting.

**15.4 Arbitration**
In the event of any dispute arising between the Society and any member, or between members, regarding the affairs of the Society, the matter shall, failing amicable settlement, be referred to arbitration in accordance with the provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The arbitration shall be conducted in Chennai, and the award of the arbitrator shall be final and binding on all parties.

**MINUTE 15: Security Arrangements – Report and Discussion**

The Secretary placed before the committee the report from M/s. SafeGuard Services, the security agency engaged for the society. The report covered the period 1 April 2023 to 30 June 2023.

1. **Deployment:** The society has two security guards on day shift (6:00 AM to 2:00 PM) and two on night shift (10:00 PM to 6:00 AM). The evening shift (2:00 PM to 10:00 PM) has one guard. The committee noted that the night shift coverage is inadequate for a society of 120 flats, especially after the recent incidents of theft in the neighbouring layout.
2. **Incident log:** The security register shows 14 entries for the quarter. Of these, 11 relate to visitors who failed to produce valid ID proof, 2 relate to unidentified persons loitering near the service gate, and 1 relates to a minor scuffle between two residents over a parking slot. The scuffle was resolved on the spot.
3. **Equipment:** The CCTV camera at the service gate has been non-functional since 18 June 2023. The agency has been informed in writing on 25 June 2023, but the camera has not been repaired or replaced so far. The Secretary was directed to issue a final notice to M/s. SafeGuard Services, asking them to restore the camera within 7 days, failing which the society will deduct an amount of Rs. 500 per day from the monthly bill.

The committee discussed the proposal to increase the number of guards on the night shift from two to three. The additional guard will be deployed only if the monthly expenditure does not exceed Rs. 12,000. The Treasurer was asked to check the budget and report at the next meeting.

The Treasurer noted that the electricity bill for October was higher than the previous month due to increased usage of the borewell pump. The committee discussed the matter and decided to review the pump timings.

---

**MINUTE 31: Maintenance Work – Waterproofing of Terrace (Block A)**

The committee reviewed the progress of the terrace waterproofing work in Block A. The contractor, Mr. Imran, had been given the work order on 15 September 2023 with a completion deadline of 31 October 2023. The Secretary reported that the work is nearly complete, however the contractor has requested an extension of one week for finishing touches. The committee agreed to grant an extension till 7 November 2023, with a penalty clause of Rs. 500 per day for further delay.

The committee also noted that the contractor had done a satisfactory patch work on the parapet wall. The final payment will be released only after a joint inspection by the Secretary and the Treasurer.

---

**MINUTE 32: Grievance from Flat No. B-402 – Follow Up**

The Secretary reported that the waterproofing repair work in the bathroom of Flat No. B-402 was completed by the owner's plumber on 12 August 2023. The complainant from Flat No. B-302 was informed of the completion. However, a fresh complaint was received on 5 November 2023 stating that there is water seepage again near the bathroom ceiling. The Secretary has contacted the owner of B-402 again and has requested them to inspect the same at the earliest. The matter will be followed up in the next meeting if not resolved.

---

**MINUTE 33: Election of New Auditor**

The term of the current auditor, M/s. Ravi & Associates, ended on 31 March 2023. The committee had proposed reappointing them for the financial year 2023-24. However, the firm has informed that they cannot take up the assignment due to internal reasons. The committee considered two other proposals – one from M/s. Srinivasan & Co. and another from M/s. Gupta & Associates. After discussion, it was resolved to appoint M/s. Srinivasan & Co. as the auditor for the financial year 2023-24. The remuneration was fixed at Rs. 12,000 per annum. The resolution was passed unanimously.

**MINUTE 39: Treasurer's Report – November 2023 Collections and Year-End Position**

The Treasurer presented the statement of income and expenditure for the month of November 2023. The total maintenance collected during November was Rs. 4,82,300 as against the expected Rs. 5,48,000. The collection percentage was about 88% as already reported in the previous meeting. The Treasurer noted that with the reminder notices issued on 2 December 2023, some defaulters have come forward. However, as per the earlier understanding, the contractor has agreed to rectify the same free of cost as part of the workmanship warranty.
